headline.text: Revenue growth is steady: guided 10% vs 10% reported
Management wording (confident vs cautious cues, -1..+1): prepared +1.00, qa +0.20

tone.method: lexical cue counts on management sentences; indicative of wording, not a measure of business health

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Our results continue the momentum we've seen over the last few quarters and reinforce the confidence that we have in our strategy for sustaining long-term growth.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Based on our better-than-expected performance year-to-date, we are raising our full year revenue growth guidance to 10%, and we plan to reinvest this outperformance in growth initiatives across our business.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We can either drop the overperformance to the bottom line and buy back more shares or we can invest to grow the business further through the wide range of attractive growth opportunities we have across our business, both in the U.S. and international.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Over a year ago, consistent with our strategic focus on strengthening our leadership in the premium space, we made the decision to make a significant investment in enhancing our flagship Platinum products in the U.S.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: When we invest in a product refresh, we expect to realize the full benefits of a year or two after launch.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: First, we anticipate increased customer engagement as well as strong demand and spend growth.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Then as we lap the investments and as the new fees kick in over time, we expect fee revenues to increase and VCE expense growth to moderate.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: And by focusing on bringing in high credit quality premium customers, we expect to see consistently strong credit performance, which supports strong earnings growth.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: With that in mind, as we enter 2026, our plan was as follows: make the upfront investments in the Platinum value propositions, which we anticipated would continue to drive the high pace of revenue growth; maintain strong credit risk management; and drive operating leverage across our marketing and operating expenses.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: The combination of high revenue growth, strong credit performance and disciplined expense management were key elements of our plan for driving mid-teens EPS growth for the fourth consecutive year.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Six months into the year, we're seeing stronger momentum than we expected.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: The investments we made in our value propositions have driven accelerated spend and revenue growth, and our Platinum portfolio is now the fastest growing in our U.S. consumer business.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Retention rates remain very high, and we continue to attract a large number of highly creditworthy customers with 65% of new consumer accounts coming from Millennials and Gen Z. Importantly, we've continued to deliver strong revenue and earnings growth while at the same time being able to invest more in customer acquisition and technology.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Over the course of the year we will continue to capitalize on the growth opportunities that position the company for long-term success.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: In looking to the second half of the year, we have great momentum.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We expect card fee growth to accelerate, credit to continue to be very strong and variable card member engagement growth to decelerate as we lap the Platinum refresh of last year.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: As the Platinum refresh laps, the key to our growth momentum over the past several years has been our focus on investing in and innovating our membership-based value propositions to attract and engage premium customers across generations and geographies.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Creating compelling premium value propositions that are competitively differentiated is not just about reward points.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: This is what our membership model delivers, and it is very difficult to replicate on a global scale.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: To build deep, enduring relationships with our premium customers, we've leaned into adding benefits they value and where they spend like travel, which is why we continue to expand our lounge and luxury hotel networks.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: And dining, which is why we acquired Resy and Tock and the proposed acquisition of TheFork, a leading online restaurant booking platform, which Resy would add 50,000 restaurants to our dining network across 11 European countries.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Deepening the engagement with our premium customers is also why we continue to introduce new digital payment capabilities such as the recent announcement that card members can redeem Membership Rewards points directly within Apple Pay, giving them greater flexibility to use their points on everyday purchases.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We're expanding partnerships with many of the premier companies in the world across a range of industries that further enrich the value of membership and drive customer engagement.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: In fact, just a few days ago, we announced a new global partnership with ALL - Accor Live Limitless, the booking and loyalty platform for Accor's portfolio of 45 worldwide hotel brands, which include Raffles, Fairmont and Sofitel.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: For example, in the second quarter, we introduced the $300 ChatGPT business annual statement credit for our U.S.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Business Platinum and Gold Card members, and we launched a pilot of our new expense management platform to an initial group of middle market customers.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We've been executing the same strategy internationally, creating premium value propositions with benefits, partnerships and experiences that are tailored to customer needs and local dynamics in each geography at price points that are typically higher than in the U.S.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Furthermore, around 70% of new consumer Platinum Card accounts outside the U.S. are coming from Millennials and Gen Z. This approach to innovating our premium value propositions has served us well, and we plan to continue implementing this successful playbook across our business.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: When compared to our historical performance, we now have more momentum in both the top and bottom lines, a more premium fee-paying customer base with strong loyalty, less credit risk, including less risk under stress, and more younger customers who represent greater lifetime value.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: In sum, we are competing from a position of strength.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We are tracking ahead of the expectations we set at the beginning of the year, generating momentum that enables us to invest more in 2026 than we initially planned and in opportunities that drive long-term growth.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: In fact, our proposed acquisition of TheFork is one of those great opportunities.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We did not have it originally in our plan at the beginning of the year and it will require investment in the second half of the year.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: As our strong performance has shown, we are winning with the next generation of premium customers and we have significant growth opportunities across our businesses and around the world.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Taken together, this gives us confidence in our long runway for sustainable growth and our ability to continue delivering attractive returns for our shareholders.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We had another strong quarter with revenue growth of 10% and EPS up 11% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The strength of our premium customer base combined with the success of our product strategy has driven accelerated momentum in the first half of the year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Spend growth stepped up to the highest level we've seen in three years, up 9% FX-adjusted, in both Q1 and Q2, and balanced growth continued to keep pace with spending.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Demand for our premium products remains strong with over 70% of new accounts acquired on fee-based products this year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The strengthening we have seen in our credit performance is a deliberate outcome of our strategy to invest in value propositions that attract customers with high credit quality.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The combination of top line momentum, excellent credit and disciplined expense management have together supported 11% revenue growth and 14% EPS growth through the first half of the year even as we have invested in our U.S.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: These results demonstrate the strength of our model and give us confidence in our ability to drive sustainable growth in line with our long-term aspiration.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Growth was broad-based across categories with goods and services spending up 9% and T&E up 10%.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: And line spending picked up further from the strong growth we saw in Q1, also up 10% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Our customers are showing strong demand for travel with global MX travel bookings up 22% year-over-year in the quarter.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: U.S. consumer spending was up 11%, the highest level of growth since Q1 2018, excluding periods impacted by the pandemic.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Millennials and Gen Z, which make up the larger share of U.S. consumer spending, remained our fastest-growing cohorts this quarter.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: SME and large global customers growing at the same pace.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We are still in the early stages of our commercial product roadmap but we are encouraged by recent trends.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: At the same time, we do expect to see impacts from the sale of the small business co-brand portfolios in the balance of the year, which I will get to a bit later when I discuss our outlook.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Growth remains broad-based across consumer and business customers and across geographies with four of our top five countries growing at a double-digit rate.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Turning to new card acquisitions: We acquired three million new cards in the quarter with continued momentum in acquiring younger customers and attracting new customers onto our fee-paying products.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Looking at balance growth and credit: Total balances increased 9% year-over-year FX-adjusted, in line with Billed Business.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The Q2 write-off rate was flat versus last quarter while the delinquency rate declined.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Provision expense of $1.1 billion included a reserve release of $191 million, mostly reflecting further strengthening of portfolio credit performance.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The strength of our model also holds in a stressed environment as demonstrated by the Fed's recently released CCAR results, which show that under a severely adverse scenario, we have the lowest projected credit card loss rate across all banks and a pretax ROE of 3.8% over nine quarters.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Turning to revenue: Revenue was up 10%, marking our fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Net card fees reached record levels, and once again were our fastest-growing line, up 15.4%.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We continue to see good momentum in attracting customers onto our premium products with 75% of new accounts acquired on fee-paying products in the quarter, the highest level we have seen since we increased our focus on premium products.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We saw around a 1 percentage point impact to year-over-year NII growth from the sale of one of the small business co-brand portfolios.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We continue to grow balances largely in line with spending while driving higher NII growth by expanding the margin earned on balances.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We are also seeing demand for our deposit products with balances from our U.S. consumer and small business banking deposit products up 9% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The step-up versus the first half of last year reflects the investment we made in the value propositions of our U.S.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Through the first half of the year, we have seen stronger spend than we expected coming into the year, including in categories like airlines, where customers earn and use rewards.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Moving on to capital: We returned $2.9 billion of capital to our shareholders, including $0.6 billion of dividends and $2.2 billion of share repurchases.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Our strong ROE enables us to return high levels of earnings to our shareholders - over 75% over the past three years.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Starting with billings and revenue: We expect to see impacts from the sale of the two small business co-brand portfolios.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Starting in Q4, we expect a quarterly impact of around 1 percentage point to spend growth and around a 2.5 percentage point impact to net interest income until we lap the portfolio sales.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: I would note that the portfolio sales will have a negligible impact to pretax income, and these impacts were incorporated in the guidance we provided for the year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: On card fees, we expect growth to accelerate in Q3 and to exit the year in the high teens, and we continue to expect credit metrics to be generally stable throughout the year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Turning to expenses: We expect marketing to be up by around 10% year-over-year in the second half of the year, driven by increased investments in customer acquisition.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We continue to expect operating expenses to grow in the mid-single digits for the full year, including the additional investment in technology we previously discussed.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We will lap the impacts of the Platinum refresh starting in Q4, resulting in lower growth in VCE expenses.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We feel really good about our momentum and our results halfway through the year, having delivered 11% revenue growth and 14% EPS growth as well as the opportunities for continued growth ahead.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Given the momentum in the business, we are raising our revenue guidance and now expect full year revenue growth of 10%.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: And as we increase investments in new customer acquisition and technology development, we are maintaining our full year EPS guidance of $17.30 to $17.90.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The guidance does not include the potential impact from the sale of our equity interest in Global Business Travel Group that we previously announced.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: One of the biggest contributors to the acceleration is the Platinum refresh.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We see that momentum coming from new card member acquisition as well as tenured card members that are increasing their spend, as well as people who have another card in their wallet and are upgrading to the Platinum card.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Platinum is definitely pulling a lot here in the acceleration.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: If you go back to Q1, we quantified that acceleration, and I talked about it in the Q1 numbers: we noted a 600 basis point acceleration across the entire Platinum portfolio in U.S. consumer.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: I think with the refresh, engagement has been really accelerated, and that's driving a lot of the spend.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: So I think as Christophe said, it's a combination of new acquisition and the engagement that we're getting with existing card members, and it is very impressive to be at 11% at this stage of the game.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Look, I think we've gotten to a point where the company has got quite large and to continue the revenue growth, it requires us to continue to invest.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Those investments come across a wide range.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: The one thing I did call out was we're pursuing the acquisition of TheFork; if all things work out, that will require deal costs and integration costs.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We're investing in technology.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We have a merchant acquiring business and a network business.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: There is no shortage of technology investments or enhancements or refreshes that need to occur.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Across a wide range of technology platforms, we're able to pull some of those investments into the second half of the year.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: To be able to get to things quicker is a huge advantage because we've got a large backlog of technology projects and getting to them sooner allows us to update platforms and deliver capabilities faster.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: The other area is card acquisition opportunities.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: To sustain growth, you need to continue to invest in acquiring high revenue-generating and high-spending cardholders.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: That's where you can think about these investments occurring: in technology, TheFork, and in card acquisition.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: You've also seen we've announced a number of things we're participating in from an agentic commerce perspective, and that requires investment as well.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: It's a strategy we've employed for a number of years and it's served us well - we've been consistently growing over the last four years with double-digit revenue growth and mid-teens EPS growth.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We announced an aggressive commercial card roadmap earlier in the year.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: You're seeing a bit of a bounce back: SME billed business was up 5% and large global customers were up 5% as well.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: From a middle market space, we've seen some softness historically, but small business has been very strong and large/global corporate has been moving along nicely.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Center, our expense management system which we just launched in pilot, should help us retain and win new business in middle market.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We've seen an uptick in SME billings over the last two quarters, and the product roadmap and the launch of the middle market expense management software will certainly help us.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We're even more advantaged from an e-commerce perspective because of fraud, data, and the ability to understand intent.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: That's why we announced the agentic insurance product months ago, where we think we'll have a huge advantage from a trust, service and security perspective over competitors because we have data on both sides: we know what the customer wanted to do and we can know what the merchant delivered.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: People are a little nervous interacting in this space, but we hope because of our knowledge of both sides of the equation, as agentic commerce takes off, customers and partners will choose us because of our ability and our historical track record of backing our customers.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We've seen the closed loop advantage in the physical world and in e-commerce; we believe it's going to play out even more over time.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The URR, for those who are not familiar, is part of the key element of our Membership Rewards program; we evaluate and quantify the ultimate rate of redemption.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: As you can imagine, there's a lot of review and work that goes into any revision of that assumption.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: So when we talk about increased investments, those sponsorships are not the primary incremental items we're adding.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We're connecting our card members and merchants, and these platforms are open, so they're also useful for non-card members from an acquisition perspective.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Within those platforms we'll provide special offers and table access for card members - an opportunity to acquire card members more cheaply and for non-card members to experience the benefits of being a card member.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Restaurants see that as access to our best customers who will spend more at their establishment.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Resy and Tock will come together from a front-end user experience perspective to provide a more integrated restaurant experience, and TheFork, given its European focus, will remain a standalone entity for now and that works.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We don't manage Resy, Tock, and TheFork on a P&L basis; we manage them as benefits that drive card member retention, customer acquisition, merchant satisfaction and spend.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: They integrate well with our travel business and add capability for our travel representatives.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: There's a lot more momentum now than 10-15 years ago: faster product refresh cycles, faster revenue momentum and billing growth.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Finally, focusing on younger card members gives us confidence in our ability to sustain growth - they come with lower initial income but we grow with them and they represent a lot of embedded future growth.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We're growing card fees at 15% year-to-date.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We expect card fee growth to accelerate in Q3 and exit Q4 in the high teens.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: So it's a slow process and the impact is delayed.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: That delayed impact is why you've seen some inertia in the growth rate; it can take roughly two years to fully flow through the P&L from beginning to end.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: But to be clear, we expect card fees to exit this year with growth in the high teens.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We reported balance sheet growth of 9% which is in line with billing growth of 9%.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: So the decline you see in the NII growth rate from 12% to 11% is largely attributable to that transfer.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Importantly, although it impacts NII, the impact to net income and earnings is negligible and was baked into our original guidance at the beginning of the year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: So no change to guidance or earnings, but you will see discontinuity in balance growth and NII growth rates due to those portfolio transfers.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: AI will play a critical role and is part of the reason we're investing.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: For the balance of the year, we expect operating expense growth to be in the mid-single digits for the full year, and we're tracking well against that.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: This quarter OpEx grew 6%, and we expect to be in the mid-single-digit range by year end.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We've deployed AI in multiple places.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: In technology, we're seeing 30% to 40% decreases in cycle time for coding.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: In servicing - travel and card servicing - we've equipped customer service and travel agents with AI-powered tools and seen a reduction in the need to accelerate hiring even as the business grows.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Over time we expect the number of representatives to decrease or at least not scale linearly with business volume due to AI-driven productivity gains.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: We've used AI in credit, risk and fraud for many years, but now we're integrating unstructured data and agentic capabilities to improve decisioning.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Integration matters: embedding AI into systems or putting layers above them is required to make it seamless.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: For example, we launched a servicing portal for our customer service representatives with embedded AI that reduces handle time and improves customer experience.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Limited-time offers and partner access are important.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: Putting it together across consumer, travel, restaurants and experiences, plus investments in lounges and fine hotels and resorts, we create a premium ecosystem that's durable.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: The durability is reinforced by momentum and the ability to reinvest over time.

signals.speaker: Stephen Squeri
signals.sentence: That scale, combined with a product flywheel that adapts to cohorts, partnerships and international focus, makes our growth algorithm more durable and gives us confidence that reinvestment today compounds into long-term growth.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: There's more momentum today than 10-15 years ago across product refresh pace and revenue momentum.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The resilience of the portfolio is stronger: reserves have declined from 2.9% at the end of 2019 to 2.7% now, reflecting a premium portfolio.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Stress testing also shows we have much lower peak write-off rates than competitors and we're profitable through a severely adverse cycle.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Finally, focusing on younger card members gives us confidence in sustaining growth: they may start with lower income but we grow with them, which represents embedded long-term growth.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: We are a momentum business, and you can expect much of the good momentum we've seen to continue in the balance of the year.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: The investments we're increasing are intended to support that momentum.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: That said, as we transfer the two small business portfolios, they will modestly reduce billed business - roughly a 1% headwind to billings.

signals.speaker: Christophe Le Caillec
signals.sentence: Our expectation is that the positive momentum will continue through the balance of the year, with that co-brand transfer headwind factored into our planning.
